commission: Harden the existing primary-phone ingress/recovery lane without changing its architecture, then continue to physical Phone Hands acceptance.

reviewedSources.finding: Local SSH health requires both an sshd process and a successful SSH protocol identification banner; PID or generic TCP-listener evidence alone is no longer accepted.
The established relay emits a non-secret heartbeat only after a successful Home Center pull or a successfully reported command completion/failure.

Recovery requires a fresh heartbeat bound to primary-phone and the exact relay PID, records the recovery reason in an append-only/local latest receipt, fails closed on unconfirmed startup, and uses 90s health / 120s startup bounds compatible with the relay's 45s request timeout.

adversarialFindings: No new daemon, queue, cloud service, browser implementation, or user-command transport was introduced.
A healthy result cannot be manufactured from a process alone: SSH requires protocol proof and relay requires a fresh successful Home Center poll.
The relay heartbeat and recovery receipt contain no bearer token, device secret, refresh token, or pairing material.
The earlier 15-second relay threshold was shorter than a legitimate 45-second network request and could create restart churn; this review hardens it to bounded 90/120-second timing.
Repository source and review receipts still do not prove the physical phone is callable. The required devices -> phone_shell -> observe -> home -> observe round-trip remains outstanding.

requiredSequence: one idempotent phone_shell canary returns exact stdout and exit receipt
recovery status/receipt is read back after a bounded relay recovery test when needed
continuation.currentSurfaceConstraint: This ChatGPT surface does not expose the authenticated Command Center/Home Center MCP or a direct phone SSH action. That is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE_ON_THIS_SURFACE, not proof that the phone ingress is globally unavailable.
